p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: In WWOX-deficient versus isogenic corrected human neural progenitors and organoids over the neurogenic window: whether MYC in radial glia is a driver, a marker of retained state or a consequence of the cell-cycle shift, by MYC within matched cell-cycle phase and potency, by genetic MYC lowering against compounds, and by add-back at several stages; then which compartment is reachable after birth. Readouts: SOX2-positive MYC-positive, pH3-positive and NEUN-positive fractions with absolute cell counts per organoid, CTIP2 and SATB2 fractions, early and late neuron signatures.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: Human organoids only: MYC transcript and protein up in three lines (DA-M01-001, 002), a radial-glia expansion and neuron loss in the knockout but not in SCAR12 (003), early-neuron signatures in both patient lines (004), a pharmacological arm with a non-selective compound in the knockout only (DR-M01-001), and a neuron-stage add-back that restores layer markers in WOREE without touching radial glia (005). Mouse: neuron-stage and progenitor-stage deletion both reproduce the null phenotype (007). No functional rescue by a selective MYC lever in any WWOX system.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: The radial-glia phase is prenatal in humans; one laboratory; three of the experiments carrying the thesis have no independent differentiations; the supplementary figures of the main paper are not available locally; MYC was not measured in any mouse model; MYCN and MYCL were not examined.

cellular_context.target_expression: WWOX is highest in radial glia in fetal single-cell and sorted data (paper Fig 3A-D); MYC falls with developmental age in the reference datasets.
cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: Radial glia, intermediate progenitors and early neurons of organoids at week 7 to 16; postnatal neuron-stage rescue at week 10 to 16.
cellular_context.limits: MYC, cell-cycle and potency are transcript-level or computational estimates; maturity within radial glia is not excluded; absence of a pharmacological CDK4/6 study in neural progenitors is 'not found'.

input.axis: M / IT11 P2.2 case: neurogenic output and neuronal maturation state, the MYC-high radial-glia substrate (Q6)

mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class
mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: A window and compartment question: whether the radial-glia MYC state is a driver, a marker or a consequence, and whether the layer-marker deficit has a reversible neuron-stage component. Partial benefit at best, protection of development and not restoration of WWOX. Track B: none.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery

p4_card.identity: A mechanism and a question, not one compound: the MYC-high radial-glia state in WWOX deficiency. Compounds named only as ex vivo comparison arms beside genetic MYC lowering: A51 (the one compound already used in a WWOX system; no catalogue identity), a covalent PIN1 probe (sulfopin; IT9 E-06), CDK4/6 inhibitors as a cell-cycle arm (palbociclib and abemaciclib; ChEMBL CHEMBL189963 and CHEMBL3301610). Lithium is a risk flag for this window, not a candidate.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WWOX-DEE only IF MYC elevation in radial glia is a driver of retained progenitor state AND a compartment reachable after birth exists. The radial-glia phase is prenatal in humans, so a postnatal use is not supported by any datum; the card concerns what to measure and what the neuron-stage add-back result already shows.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NOT NEW as a pathway (need NEED-MYC-PROGENITOR-PROLIFERATION; cards D01 and D02). NEW as a framing: driver versus marker versus consequence, with the SCAR12 dissociation, the mouse conditional-deletion reading and the neuron-stage reversible component as discriminating inputs.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: D01 (A51, abstention-level), D02 (Wnt-lowering, abstention), G01 (lithium), IT9 P4c-e records E-03 to E-06, IT10 v4 Q6 dispositions.
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE; Track A; window protection at best.
p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN. The experiment decides whether radial-glia MYC lowering is worth any further lever, and whether the layer-marker deficit that neuron-stage add-back restores should be the endpoint for the neuron compartment instead.
p4_card.mechanism: Targets named only as arms: MYC (HGNC:7553), PIN1, CDK4 and CDK6. Direction wanted: lower MYC activity only IF it is a harmful driver; lengthen G1 only IF cycle shortening is causal. Guards in generation_it9_p1_20261030/guards.tsv bind: the MYC-positive fraction magnitudes and the A51 arm values are endpoint baselines and cannot evaluate a compound.

for: MYC protein fraction and transcript are up in radial glia of three mutant lines (one laboratory).
WWOX loss raises Myc and WWOX restoration lowers Myc protein in a non-neural p53-null system (same laboratory).
MYCN dosage shows the progenitor pool and cortical size respond to MYC-family level in both directions.
A non-selective compound moved progenitor and pan-neuron fractions toward wild type in the knockout.
against: MYC is elevated in SCAR12 organoids whose radial-glia fraction is wild-type-like and whose neurons are not reduced, so elevation alone does not give the composition phenotype. (IT12 P1-main correction, 2026-10-31: the SCAR12 organoid lines are two siblings carrying ONE allele, c.1114G>C p.Gly372Arg, a C-terminal missense; this is neither the reference class (Q230P) nor 'SCAR12 missense lines' in general)
POU5F1 is as prominent as MYC in the knockout radial-glia contrast, which fits retained progenitor state without a MYC-specific driver.
The WWOX-MYC inverse relation in reference data is a developmental time course.

Neuron-stage deletion in mouse reproduces the null phenotype, and neuron-stage add-back restores layer markers and firing without correcting radial glia, so the radial-glia MYC state is not shown to be needed for those endpoints.
Progressive microcephaly is part of the clinical picture (4 of 5 in one cohort), and MYCN loss gives microcephaly: lowering MYC-family output could shrink the progenitor pool.
The one compound used lowers two pathways, the arm has no wild-type-plus-compound group, no absolute counts and no independent differentiation.
No pharmacological CDK4/6 study in cortical progenitors was found; lithium expands progenitor pools in vitro through Wnt.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: No datum from a WWOX-deficient neural cell at G1 duration, at MYC after add-back at the progenitor stage, or with a selective MYC lever; all compound rows other than A51 are NOT WWOX EVIDENCE.

p4_card.pharmacology: A51: no catalogue identity, targets and exposure unknown. Sulfopin: research probe, no human exposure (IT9 E-06). Palbociclib and abemaciclib: oral small molecules with nanomolar aggregated potency on CDK4 and CDK6 in the compound database; label, paediatric and neural-progenitor data not searched. Omomyc is a mini-protein with no catalogue identity and was not carried. Lithium: GSK-3 and inositol monophosphatase inhibition in the database; risk flag only.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for any candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

p4_card.predictions: None; no engine, no score. The experiment is proposed, not performed.
p4_card.next_measurement: Test T1 (computational, on the deposited single-cell data if access is obtained): MYC difference between knockout and wild-type radial glia within the G1/G0 phase alone and within matched potency strata, and the same for POU5F1; if the difference vanishes, MYC is a marker of cycle or state. Test T2 (wet-lab): in knockout and corrected cells from two independent clones, genetic MYC lowering (inducible degron or CRISPRi) against a cytostatic control and against the compound arms, with SOX2-positive MYC-positive, pH3-positive and NEUN-positive fractions and absolute cell counts per organoid, wild-type plus compound groups included; add-back at progenitor stage (before week 4) and at neuron stage (week 10) with MYC and layer-marker readouts. Test T3: MYC in the SCAR12 line stratified by the same strata, to ask whether MYC elevation without composition change is a stage effect. Falsifier: MYC lowering by a specific lever does not move neuronal fractions or the progenitor fraction in knockout cells beyond what it does in corrected cells.
p4_card.value_added: Separates the driver, marker and consequence readings of the radial-glia MYC rise with within-paper discriminators (SCAR12, POU5F1, developmental co-variation, cell-cycle coupling), adds the mouse conditional-deletion and neuron-stage add-back readings that bound what a radial-glia lever can matter for, and records that the engine's Q6 rows are one origin and cannot decide. Reading of the one compound result: the authors read A51 as MYC-driven impairment of differentiation (NEUN-positive up, SATB2 mildly up, CTIP2 unchanged); that no candidate is strengthened here rests on the non-selectivity of the multi-kinase compound and on design gaps (no wild-type-plus-compound arm, supplement unavailable), not on a contradicting result.
p4_card.clinical_census: UNKNOWN: ClinicalTrials.gov was not queried in this package.
